prompt: Create a delicate single-character anime-style illustration on a clean white background. Show a young woman in a three-quarter back view, turned over her shoulder toward the viewer with a calm, slightly wistful expression. She has very long black hair gathered into a high loose ponytail, with many fine stray strands and a large navy blue bow tied near the top. Her face is soft and pale with subtle blush, narrow gray eyes, small lips, and refined linework. She wears a romantic vintage outfit: an off-white blouse with a ruffled high collar, ruffled cuffs, loose puffed sleeves, and a deep navy blue high-waisted skirt or corset waist with black lace-up ties visible at the back. Her right hand is raised delicately, holding exactly 1 dandelion puff on a thin green stem beside her face. Use an airy hand-drawn manga illustration style with clean sketchy black outlines, very light watercolor-like shading, muted colors, minimal background detail, graceful proportions, and lots of negative space. Keep the composition vertical, waist-up to upper-thigh framing, the hair flowing down the left side of the image, and avoid any text, watermark, extra characters, or additional objects.
